d.ko:
Multi Turret Academy is a top-down tank action game with roguelike elements. 
Select your vehicle from a growing list of historical models, then equip dozens of weapons and upgrades to lead your local tank club to victory!
d.en:
Multi Turret Academy is a top-down tank action game with roguelike elements. 
Select your vehicle from a growing list of historical models, then equip dozens of weapons and upgrades to lead your local tank club to victory!
d.zh:
《多炮塔神教》是一个稍微带点肉鸽要素的俯视角坦克射击游戏，你将作为苏联车长指挥各种二战坦克参加模拟战。
在战斗中，你可以缴获敌车的炮塔来增强自己，并招募形形色色的学生们加入车组，和你一起赢得胜利。
